South Melbourne Wins Australia Cup Final on Record Night

South Melbourne has won the Australia Cup final, an event described as a record-breaking night. In a separate sporting event, Matt Renshaw scored his first Test century since January 2017, helping Australia surpass 300 runs on the second day of a match in Durban.
